svg.title: A2: Gaussian prefactor (source line 1317). The extracted exponent −rh+dv is replaced by −(rh + dv). The active, dormant and frozen-link counts, and the substitution mg = c( √ 2πg)r, are calculated in Section 6.2. The dormant Gaussian integrates to one, and its normalization remains present. The determinant factor is unchanged. This calculation fixes the normalization used by the chart integral.
